const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
const int MAX_NODES = 210;

struct Edge {
    int to, capacity, reverse_index;
    Edge(int t, int c, int r) : to(t), capacity(c), reverse_index(r) {}
};

vector<Edge> adj[MAX_NODES];
int level[MAX_NODES], progress[MAX_NODES];

void insert_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
    adj[u].emplace_back(v, cap, adj[v].size());
    adj[v].emplace_back(u, 0, adj[u].size() - 1);
}

void compute_levels(int source) {
    memset(level, -1, sizeof(level));
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(source);
    level[source] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (const auto& e : adj[u]) {
            if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int push_flow(int node, int sink, int bottleneck) {
    if (node == sink) return bottleneck;
    for (int& i = progress[node]; i < (int)adj[node].size(); ++i) {
        Edge& e = adj[node][i];
        if (e.capacity > 0 && level[node] < level[e.to]) {
            int pushed = push_flow(e.to, sink, min(bottleneck, e.capacity));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.capacity -= pushed;
                adj[e.to][e.reverse_index].capacity += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int compute_max_flow(int source, int sink) {
    int total_flow = 0;

        if (level[sink] < 0) break;

        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = push_flow(source, sink, INF)) > 0) {
            total_flow += pushed;
        }
    }
    return total_flow;
}
